name: Efficient Rest-Deposit
hypothesis: Previous attempts failed because mandatory deposit rules caused agents to stop immediately after gathering one item, preventing full capacity utilization (cargo=1 instead of 3). By changing the 'carrying' condition to only trigger when cargo exceeds half capacity (cargo>1), agents will carry multiple harvests per trip. Combined with a fixed rest interval, this should maximize trips per 720 steps and stored food.
